items.q: the drummer's name was Debo Mills who I played with with Lloyd Hunter who was a great jazz drummer

ctx.x: He joined Horace Henderson's band along

with some of the other musicians around Omaha; the drummer's name was Debo Mills who I played with with Lloyd Hunter who was a great jazz drummer. and he was with some other musicians. I can't remember all of their names.
